title: Stream descriptor for the Kafka Protocol Binding (0.3.0)
description: Deployment declarations for an OpenCDC stream on Kafka, carried as the value of the control-topic record keyed opencdc:descriptor (Section 6.2). Normative for the stream deployment. They are not stream declarations; those live in STREAM_METADATA. Clients MUST ignore members they do not recognise (B-KFK-16).

bindingVersion.description: Binding document version, <wire>.<revision>, without any -wip suffix. Clients check the <wire> component (B-KFK-16).

stream.description: Stream name; the <stream> of the topic naming convention (B-KFK-8).

contentMode.description: CloudEvents content mode of every record on the data and transaction topics (B-KFK-1). Control-topic records are always structured (B-KFK-2).

controlTopic.description: Name of the topic holding this descriptor (B-KFK-36).

partitions.description: Current partition count; fixed for the life of the stream (B-KFK-51).

subjects.description: Subjects whose events may appear on this topic (B-KFK-30).

replayWindow.description: ISO 8601 duration no longer than the smallest data-topic retention.ms, or 'unbounded' (B-KFK-45).

maxEventBytes.description: Largest record value the stream admits, UTF-8 bytes before compression (B-KFK-27).
